### Added

- (agent-platform) [Port to kagent api.kagent.dev/v1alpha3 Agents and Sessions](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2727) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — The Agent Platform reads agents and sessions through kagent's `api.kagent.dev` API, so agents show and sessions start on installations whose kagent runs it. The create form and the edit page take an agent's extra egress origins, which its Configuration card lists.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Offer the pull request only for deleting an agent applied from git](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2818) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On an agent's page, deleting an agent created in the portal no longer offers a `Commit` that had nothing to remove. Where agent-manager supports pull requests, `Delete agent…` on an agent applied from git opens one with `Open pull request`.
- (agent-platform) [Normalise an attachment's base64 without a regex](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2824) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a session's page, an attachment near the size limit is shown as too large instead of breaking the message's rendering with `Maximum call stack size exceeded`.
- (gs) [Drop the Alerts link from the cluster details page's default links](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2816) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The cluster details page's tools card no longer shows an `Alerts` link by default, which led customers to a Grafana page they can't open. A portal that sets `gs.clusterDetails.resources` keeps exactly the links it lists, without the defaults showing first.
- (gs) [Scope the Deployments page's Mimir queries by cluster, retry once](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2825) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The Deployments page and a cluster's Deployments tab ask Mimir only about the clusters they show, so they no longer time out under load. A slow Mimir shows one error per query instead of a minute of retries.
- (gs) [Keep the router state when the installation scope writes the URL](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2821) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Starting an Agent Platform session from an agent's page sends the prompt again. With an installation selected in the header, such a session sometimes opened with no first message and no answer.
- (plans) [The Hive team filter narrows Now, History and Plans](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2806) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The team chosen in Hive's header narrows the Now and History tabs, and the Plans tab shows that team's plans repository, with a repository picker only for `All teams`. For a team the magazine doesn't follow, a note `Hive follows Team …` links the team's board.
- (plans) [Hive tabs and Plans page wait out a paused retry](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2817) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After a failed read in a background tab, Hive's Now, History and Knowledge tabs and the Plans page show their loading state until the retry answers, instead of a blank tab.

### Development and CI/CD

- (build) [Define the tsc heap size once, in scripts/tsc.sh](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2826) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — `yarn tsc` and `yarn tsc:full` pass on a fresh checkout without `NODE_OPTIONS` in the shell; the heap size is set once, in `scripts/tsc.sh`.
- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2814) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared team-label and project-board workflows.
